title: Megurine Luka — Between You And Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Phew... That was close!
Huh? Luka?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hi, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's wrong? You seem pretty flustered...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. The thing is, I went over to see An just now, and...

rows.Speaker: Elena's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Are you on the phone with someone, An?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
Which is why you rushed back.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Exactly!
If it had been someone other than me, they probably would have ended up getting spotted!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They'd get everyone's attention, everyone would come over, and it would be a whole huge scene!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Phew... So, thank goodness! That really was a close one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, it certainly would draw attention...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm very glad that you didn't get seen.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I am very good at running away, after all! I've been training quite a lot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you've been training?
This is news to me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, MEIKO, as a special treat, I'll tell you all about my special training regimen!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO, what you're eating there. Is it a new dessert item?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, MEIKO asked me to taste a new item she's trying out! Hehe. Cake always tastes so much better when someone asks you to have it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can steal a small bite while he's bragging to Len...! Mmm! This is so good...!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Luka? I didn't realize you were here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Nom...
Oh yeah, I am!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
There seems to be one less strawberry on top now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you know what happened to it, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I just remembered that I have an urgent appointment! See you later!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was you, wasn't it, Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Luka. Just like you ordered, apple cider with lemon slices on the rim, for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku! I'll just place it here, and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, switcheroo complete!
Len's going to be so surprised when he sees that his lemon tea's turned into a glass of soda!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Phew... I'm back! Man, I'm parched!
Bottoms up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What the?! Why's this so fizzy?!
Is it carbonated?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Yes, he looks really startled! Hehe. My prank succeeded♪)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is actually pretty good too... But I know Luka was behind this!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've gotten better at making sandwiches, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have MEIKO to thank for teaching me so much! Now I can help you with that new menu item!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll be making the drinks. All you need to do is follow the recipe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's see... First, I need to dress the steamed broccoli and chicken in the honey mustard sauce...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did a customer just walk in, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I'm not seeing anyone.
But I thought I heard the bell just now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
What's this drink doing here? I don't remember making it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honestly, all my hard work has led to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, huh? Is something wrong, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're unbelievable...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Uh oh...! This means I'm about to get scolded...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By training, you meant becoming better at pulling pranks, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Bye now, MEIKO!
There's something that I need to do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Stop right there, Luka!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Honestly...
She really is good at running away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But she did give me that drink as a gift...so I suppose I can let her go this time.
